edge_case_rules.empty_utterance: C2.1 substance fail → C3 NOT_MEASURED (do not emit C3 verdict; route to PARTIAL_PASS_FRAGMENTARY upstream)
edge_case_rules.all_axis_collapse: 5-axis activation max - min < 1e-6 (uniform) → C3.2 mark as DEGENERATE; cell verdict = FAIL (synthetic_fallback artifact suspect; require real-mode retest)
edge_case_rules.nan_value: any cell value NaN/Inf → cell verdict = FAIL (do not propagate); ensemble row excluded from EMC mean (N adjusted), PPR_v2 counts row as non-PASS
edge_case_rules.zero_variance_ensemble: cell std == 0 across all N → mark cell as DEGENERATE; exclude from EMC ≥3-of-4 numerator + denominator (effective EMC floor reduces to ≥3 of (4-degenerate))
edge_case_rules.single_sample_n1: PPR_v2/EMC_v2 N/A → emit BASELINE_MEASURED only (single-probe lane); no C3 PASS/FAIL verdict
edge_case_rules.negative_threshold: direction='le' with computed threshold < 0 → reject threshold, fall back to constrained='neg_only' (random fail-rate ≥0.95 hard floor)
edge_case_rules.missing_cell_data: any of 4 cells missing → C3 verdict = INDETERMINATE (do not coerce to FAIL; iter4 followup mandate)
edge_case_rules.v4_prompt_subset: if N_prompts < 15 (V4 prompt subset only), ensemble verdict = INDETERMINATE (PPR_v2 floor 0.6 = ≥9/15 strict)
